---
title: "Multiple imputation of the crawled track: does interpolated pseudo-data drive the Hangang HMM?"
author: "Youn Jae Kang"
date: "2026-10-21"
output: html_document
---

The main pipeline (03 → 04 → 06) fits the HMMs to a regularised track: the crawl posterior mean.
Here `n_sims` draws equally plausible versions of that track, and the results are combined with Rubin's rules. 
(Multiple Imputation; McClintock 2017,McClintock & Michelot 2018).

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(lubridate)
library(momentuHMM)
library(argosfilter)
library(MASS, exclude = "select")
library(parallel)
library(suncalc)
```

# A. Main model and helpers
```{r reference}
prep_for_ci <- function(fit) {
  fit$data[] <- lapply(fit$data, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) as.numeric(x) else x)
  environment(fit$conditions$formula) <- globalenv()
  fit
}
ref_model   <- prep_for_ci(readRDS(paths$ref_model))
scaling_ref <- readRDS(paths$scaling_ref)
fixed_step  <- c(t(ref_model$mle$step))    # main base values: means (Travel, Forage, Roost), SDs
fixed_angle <- c(t(ref_model$mle$angle))   # means, concentrations
ref_beta    <- ref_model$mle$beta

hmm_dist    <- list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm")
states      <- c("Travel", "Forage", "Roost")
dyn_formula <- ~ Han_Temp + Han_Wind + Han_SPI6 + Han_wTemp + Han_BOD + Han_DTN + Han_Chlor
cov_vars    <- c("Temp", "Wind", "wTemp", "BOD", "Chlor", "DTN", "SPI6")
han_vars    <- paste0("Han_", cov_vars)
z_ref <- function(x, var) (x - scaling_ref[[paste0(var, "_mu")]]) / scaling_ref[[paste0(var, "_sd")]]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(ref_beta), c("1 -> 2", "1 -> 3", "2 -> 1", "2 -> 3", "3 -> 1", "3 -> 2")))

beta_vcov <- function(m) {
  b <- m$mle$beta; est <- m$mod$estimate; S <- m$mod$Sigma
  if (is.null(S) && !is.null(m$mod$hessian)) {     
    free <- setdiff(seq_along(est), m$conditions$optInd)
    S0   <- tryCatch(ginv(m$mod$hessian), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(S0) && nrow(S0) == length(free)) {
      S <- matrix(0, length(est), length(est)); S[free, free] <- S0
    }
  }
  if (is.null(S) || inherits(S, "error")) return(NULL)
  nb  <- length(b)
  off <- which(vapply(0:(length(est) - nb), function(o)
    isTRUE(all.equal(est[o + seq_len(nb)], c(b), tolerance = 1e-8)), logical(1))) - 1
  if (length(off) != 1) return(NULL)
  V <- S[off + seq_len(nb), off + seq_len(nb)]
  if (any(!is.finite(V)) || any(diag(V) <= 0)) return(NULL)
  nm <- paste(rep(colnames(b), each = nrow(b)), rep(rownames(b), ncol(b)), sep = " | ")
  dimnames(V) <- list(nm, nm)
  V
}
stopifnot(!is.null(beta_vcov(ref_model)))        
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(sqrt(diag(beta_vcov(ref_model))), c(CIbeta(ref_model)$beta$se),
                           tolerance = 1e-6, check.attributes = FALSE)))
```

```{r observed fixes}
  mutate(dt = as.numeric(difftime(time, lag(time), units = "mins")),

  ungroup() %>%

  group_by(ID) %>% filter(n() >= min_points) %>% ungroup() %>%
```

# C. Tracks and imputations
```{r main track}
pub_hg  <- as.data.frame(ref_model$data)
hmm_ids <- unique(as.character(pub_hg$ID))
min_key <- function(id, t) paste(as.character(id), round(as.numeric(floor_date(t, "minute"))))
sec_key <- function(id, t) paste(as.character(id), round(as.numeric(t)))
pub_key <- min_key(pub_hg$ID, pub_hg$time)

mean_path <- read.csv(paths$hmm_ready, colClasses = c(time = "character")) %>%
  transmute(ID      = as.character(ID),
            time_04 = as.POSIXct(time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC"),   # as 04 read it
            time    = ymd_hms(time, truncated = 3, tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE),     # exact time
            x, y) %>%
  filter(ID %in% hmm_ids, !is.na(time_04)) %>%
  distinct(ID, time_04, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%                                 # as 04
  mutate(rmin = minute(round_date(time_04, "30 min"))) %>%
  filter(rmin == 30 | (ID == "br23018_11" & rmin == 0)) %>%                  # 04's 1-h subsample
  arrange(ID, time) %>%
  select(ID, time, x, y) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Steps (m) and angles of a track, as prepData() computes them in 04
track_steps <- function(d) {
  p <- prepData(d[, c("ID", "time", "x", "y")], type = "UTM", coordNames = c("x", "y"))
  data.frame(ID = as.character(p$ID), time = p$time, x = p$x, y = p$y, step = p$step, angle = p$angle)
}
# Hangang data with the step lengths (km) and turning angles of a track
hangang_from_track <- function(tr) {
  m <- match(pub_key, min_key(tr$ID, tr$time))
  if (anyNA(m)) stop("track lacks ", sum(is.na(m)), " rows of the main data")
  hg <- pub_hg
  hg$x <- tr$x[m]; hg$y <- tr$y[m]
  hg$step  <- tr$step[m] / 1000
  hg$step[which(hg$step == 0)] <- 1e-4                         # as 04
  hg$angle <- tr$angle[m]
  hg$step[is.na(pub_hg$step)]   <- NA                          
  hg$angle[is.na(pub_hg$angle)] <- NA
  as_hmm(hg)
}

# j = 0 reproduce the HMM data
hg0 <- hangang_from_track(track_steps(mean_path))
pos_dev  <- max(sqrt((hg0$x - pub_hg$x)^2 + (hg0$y - pub_hg$y)^2))
step_dev <- 1000 * max(abs(hg0$step - pub_hg$step), na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(pos_dev < 1e-3, step_dev < match_tol_m,
          !anyNA(hg0$step[!is.na(pub_hg$step)]), !anyNA(hg0$angle[!is.na(pub_hg$angle)]))

# Real fixes of these bursts
fixes <- obs_seg %>% filter(ID %in% hmm_ids) %>% arrange(ID, time)
stopifnot("bursts of the main HMM not rebuilt from the raw fixes" = all(hmm_ids %in% fixes$ID))
```

## dynamic Brownian bridge
Random movement between fixes comes from the dynamic Brownian bridge movement model (Kranstauber et al. 2012, J. Anim. Ecol.; Horne et al. 2007, Ecology). At every fix, the Brownian motion variance σ² is estimated by maximum likelihood in a sliding window of `bb_window` fixes: each interior fix is left out and predicted by straight-line interpolation between its neighbours, with variance:
T·α(1−α)·σ² + ((1−α)² + α²)·δ² per axis 
(T = time between the neighbours, α = fraction of T elapsed at the fix, δ = GPS error `bb_gps_error_m`). 

The track is cut into day/night (sun altitude `bb_twilight_deg`), at moves longer than `bb_break_km` between consecutive fixes (migration) and at gaps longer than `bb_long_gap_h`. σ² is then estimated per gap:
```{r motion variance}
fixes_ll  <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(fixes, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32649), 4326))
fixes$day <- getSunlightPosition(data = data.frame(date = fixes$time, lat = fixes_ll[, "Y"],
                                                   lon = fixes_ll[, "X"]))$altitude > bb_twilight_deg * pi / 180

bb_gap_sigma2 <- function(f) {     # f: fixes of one burst sorted by time -> sigma^2 (m^2/h) and kind of every gap
  n  <- nrow(f); th <- as.numeric(f$time) / 3600
  Tg <- diff(th); dg <- sqrt(diff(f$x)^2 + diff(f$y)^2)
  run <- cumsum(c(TRUE, f$day[-1] != f$day[-n] | dg > bb_break_km * 1000 | Tg > bb_long_gap_h))
  i  <- 2:(n - 1)                  # residual k is fix i[k] = k + 1 left out
  T  <- th[i + 1] - th[i - 1]; a <- (th[i] - th[i - 1]) / T
  r2 <- (f$x[i] - (f$x[i - 1] + a * (f$x[i + 1] - f$x[i - 1])))^2 +
        (f$y[i] - (f$y[i - 1] + a * (f$y[i + 1] - f$y[i - 1])))^2
  A  <- T * a * (1 - a); E <- ((1 - a)^2 + a^2) * bb_gps_error_m^2
  pure <- run[i - 1] == run[i] & run[i + 1] == run[i]
  ml  <- function(w) {
    nll <- function(ls2) { v <- A[w] * exp(ls2) + E[w]; sum(log(v) + r2[w] / (2 * v)) }
    exp(optimize(nll, c(log(1e-2), log(1e10)))$minimum)
  }
  inc <- function(g) max((dg[g]^2 / 2 - 2 * bb_gps_error_m^2) / Tg[g], 1e-2)
  out <- lapply(seq_len(n - 1), function(g) {
    if (Tg[g] > bb_long_gap_h) return(list(inc(g), "long gap"))
    if (run[g] == run[g + 1]) {
      k <- which(pure & run[i] == run[g])
      if (!length(k)) return(list(inc(g), "run < 3 fixes"))
      k <- k[order(abs(i[k] - (g + 0.5)))][seq_len(min(bb_window, length(k)))]
      return(list(ml(k), if (f$day[g]) "day" else "night"))
    }
    k <- intersect(c(g - 1, g), seq_along(i))     # residuals at the gap's two end fixes
    kind <- if (dg[g] > bb_break_km * 1000) "long move" else "twilight"
    if (!length(k)) return(list(inc(g), kind))
    list(ml(k), kind)
  })
  data.frame(gap = seq_len(n - 1), s2 = vapply(out, `[[`, numeric(1), 1),
             kind = vapply(out, `[[`, character(1), 2))
}
gap_list <- lapply(split(fixes, fixes$ID), function(f) {
  f <- f[order(f$time), ]
  data.frame(ID = f$ID[1], start = f$time[-nrow(f)], end = f$time[-1], bb_gap_sigma2(f))
})

# Between two fixes.
pert <- bind_rows(lapply(hmm_ids, function(id) {
  r  <- which(mean_path$ID == id); t <- as.numeric(mean_path$time[r])
  h  <- sort(as.numeric(pub_hg$time[pub_hg$ID == id]))
  k  <- findInterval(t, h)
  near <- pmin(abs(t - h[pmax(k, 1)]), abs(h[pmin(k + 1, length(h))] - t)) <= seg_margin_h * 3600
  gs <- gap_list[[id]]; o <- as.numeric(gs$start); o <- c(o, as.numeric(gs$end[nrow(gs)]))
  g  <- findInterval(t, o)
  ok <- near & g >= 1 & g < length(o) & t > o[pmax(g, 1)]
  data.frame(row = r[ok], ID = id, gap = g[ok],
             tau = (t[ok] - o[g[ok]]) / 3600, T = (o[g[ok] + 1] - o[g[ok]]) / 3600,
             s2  = gs$s2[g[ok]], kind = gs$kind[g[ok]])
}))
write.csv(bind_rows(gap_list) %>% transmute(ID, start, end, kind, sigma_m_per_sqrt_h = sqrt(s2)),
          file.path(paths$out_dir, "mi_bb_gap_sigma.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Draw the noise
Within each gap the noise is a Brownian bridge with that gap's σ², simulated sequentially at the hourly
rows: zero at both fixes, independent between gaps.
```{r draw noise}
draw_bb <- function(p) {
  n <- nrow(p); bx <- by <- numeric(n); zx <- rnorm(n); zy <- rnorm(n)
  key <- paste(p$ID, p$gap); prev <- ""; s <- 0; px <- 0; py <- 0
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    if (key[k] != prev) { prev <- key[k]; s <- 0; px <- 0; py <- 0 }   
    w  <- (p$T[k] - p$tau[k]) / (p$T[k] - s)                           
    sd <- sqrt(p$s2[k] * (p$tau[k] - s) * (p$T[k] - p$tau[k]) / (p$T[k] - s))
    px <- px * w + sd * zx[k]; py <- py * w + sd * zy[k]
    bx[k] <- px; by[k] <- py; s <- p$tau[k]
  }
  data.frame(row = p$row, ID = p$ID, dx = bx, dy = by)
}
set.seed(2026)
noise <- lapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(j) draw_bb(pert))

imputed <- function(id) tag_of[base_id(id)] %in% impute_tags

track_j <- function(j) {
  d <- mean_path
  if (j > 0) {
    nz <- noise[[j]][imputed(noise[[j]]$ID), ]
    d$x[nz$row] <- d$x[nz$row] + nz$dx
    d$y[nz$row] <- d$y[nz$row] + nz$dy
  }
  track_steps(d)
}
tracks  <- lapply(0:n_sims, track_j)
hg_list <- lapply(tracks, hangang_from_track)
names(tracks) <- names(hg_list) <- 0:n_sims
```

```{r spread checks}
                             labels = c("<=30 min", "1 h", "2 h", "4 h", "4-12 h", ">12 h"))

print(pos_diag %>% filter(used) %>% mutate(gap = gap_class(gap_h)) %>%
        group_by(gap) %>%
        summarise(rows = n(), median_sd_m = median(sd_m), p90_sd_m = quantile(sd_m, 0.9),
```

# D. Fit the 04 dynamic HMM to every imputation
```{r fit imputations}
js <- 0:n_sims
fit_tasks <- lapply(js, function(j) {
  f <- file.path(paths$out_dir, sprintf("mi_%s_fit_%02d.rds", run_tag, j))
  list(j = j, file = f, hg = if (file.exists(f)) NULL else hg_list[[as.character(j)]],
       fixed_step = fixed_step, fixed_angle = fixed_angle,
       ref_beta = ref_beta, hmm_dist = hmm_dist, dyn_formula = dyn_formula, nlm_par = nlm_par,
       prep_for_ci = prep_for_ci)
})

fit_one <- function(tk) {
  if (file.exists(tk$file)) return(readRDS(tk$file))
  res <- if (inherits(tk$hg, "error")) list(ok = FALSE, why = conditionMessage(tk$hg)) else
    tryCatch({
      dm <- momentuHMM::fitHMM(data = tk$hg, nbStates = 3, dist = tk$hmm_dist,
                               Par0 = list(step = tk$fixed_step, angle = tk$fixed_angle),
                               beta0 = tk$ref_beta, estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
                               fixPar = list(step = tk$fixed_step, angle = tk$fixed_angle),
                               formula = tk$dyn_formula, nlmPar = tk$nlm_par)
      list(ok = TRUE, dyn = tk$prep_for_ci(dm))
    }, error = function(e) list(ok = FALSE, why = conditionMessage(e)))
  saveRDS(res, tk$file)
  res
}

cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
invisible(clusterEvalQ(cl, { library(momentuHMM); NULL }))
fits <- tryCatch(parLapplyLB(cl, fit_tasks, fit_one), finally = stopCluster(cl))
names(fits) <- js
rm(fit_tasks)

fit_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(fits), function(j) {
  f <- fits[[j]]
  if (inherits(f, "try-error") || !isTRUE(f$ok))
    return(data.frame(imputation = as.integer(j), valid = FALSE,
                      note = if (is.list(f)) f$why else as.character(f)))
  no_cov <- is.null(beta_vcov(f$dyn))
  data.frame(imputation = as.integer(j),
             valid = !no_cov,
             note  = if (no_cov) "no covariance" else "",
             n_hangang = nrow(f$dyn$data),
             pct_step_observed = round(100 * mean(!is.na(f$dyn$data$step)), 1),
             dyn_code = f$dyn$mod$code)
}))
#write.csv(fit_tab, file.path(paths$out_dir, paste0("mi_", run_tag, "_fits.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

use <- as.character(fit_tab$imputation[fit_tab$valid & fit_tab$imputation > 0])
m   <- length(use)
if (m < 5) stop("Fewer than 5 valid imputations; check fit_tab before pooling.")
```

# E. Pooled transition betas
Each beta is pooled across the m imputations with Rubin's rules: total variance T = W + (1 + 1/m) × B
(W = mean within-imputation variance, B = between-imputation variance), and a 95% interval.
```{r pool betas}
rubin <- function(est, v, alpha = 0.05) {
  m <- length(est); qbar <- mean(est); W <- mean(v); B <- var(est)
  Tt  <- W + (1 + 1 / m) * B
  lam <- (1 + 1 / m) * B / Tt
  df  <- if (lam > 0) (m - 1) / lam^2 else Inf
  h   <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df) * sqrt(Tt)
  c(Est = qbar, SE = sqrt(Tt), Lower = qbar - h, Upper = qbar + h, lambda = lam)
}

E <- t(sapply(use, function(j) c(fits[[j]]$dyn$mle$beta)))
V <- t(sapply(use, function(j) diag(beta_vcov(fits[[j]]$dyn))))
pooled <- as.data.frame(t(sapply(seq_len(ncol(E)), function(k) rubin(E[, k], V[, k]))))
pooled <- pooled[, c("Est", "SE", "Lower", "Upper")]
pooled$Covariate  <- rep(rownames(ref_beta), times = ncol(ref_beta))
pooled$Transition <- rep(colnames(ref_beta), each  = nrow(ref_beta))

ci_ref <- CIbeta(ref_model)$beta
pub <- data.frame(Covariate  = rep(rownames(ci_ref$est), times = ncol(ci_ref$est)),
                  Transition = rep(colnames(ci_ref$est), each  = nrow(ci_ref$est)),
                  Est_pub = c(ci_ref$est), Lower_pub = c(ci_ref$lower), Upper_pub = c(ci_ref$upper))

# j = 0: the main data refitted here; should equal Est_pub (checks the refitting itself)
pub$Est_meanpath <- if (isTRUE(fits[["0"]]$ok)) c(fits[["0"]]$dyn$mle$beta) else NA_real_

mi_beta <- pub %>%
  left_join(pooled, by = c("Covariate", "Transition")) %>%
  mutate(Sig_pub   = Lower_pub > 0 | Upper_pub < 0,
         Sig_MI    = Lower > 0 | Upper < 0,
         Status    = case_when(sign(Est) != sign(Est_pub) ~ "FLIP",
                               Sig_MI ~ "kept", TRUE ~ "n.s."),
         Transition_name = paste(states[as.integer(substr(Transition, 1, 1))], "->",
                                 states[as.integer(substr(Transition, 6, 6))])) %>%
  select(Covariate, Transition, Transition_name, Est_pub, Lower_pub, Upper_pub, Sig_pub,
         Est_meanpath, Est_MI = Est, SE_MI = SE, Lower_MI = Lower, Upper_MI = Upper, Sig_MI,
         Status)

cat("\nMean path vs main betas: r =", round(cor(mi_beta$Est_meanpath, mi_beta$Est_pub), 3), "\n")

# The effects reported in the paper (significant in the main model)
reported <- mi_beta %>% filter(Sig_pub, Covariate != "(Intercept)") %>% arrange(Transition, Covariate)
print(as_tibble(reported) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))), width = Inf, n = Inf)
#print(reported %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))), width = Inf)

cat("\nReported effects:", nrow(reported),
    "| kept:", sum(reported$Status == "kept"), "| n.s.:", sum(reported$Status == "n.s."),
    "| flipped:", sum(reported$Status == "FLIP"), "\n")
cat("Intercepts (baseline switching):\n")
print(mi_beta %>% filter(Covariate == "(Intercept)") %>%
        select(Transition_name, Est_pub, Lower_pub, Upper_pub, Est_MI, Lower_MI, Upper_MI))
```

```{r bout helpers}
# z-scored future Hangang covariates of one SSP file, wintering months only (as 06)
read_future <- function(file) {
  read.csv(file) %>%
    mutate(Date_Time  = as.POSIXct(Date_Time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
           Han_Temp   = z_ref(Temperature.C.,   "Temp"),
           Han_Wind   = z_ref(Wind_Speed.m.s.,  "Wind"),

           Han_wTemp  = z_ref(Pred_Water_Temp,  "wTemp"),
           Han_BOD    = z_ref(Pred_BOD,         "BOD"),
           Han_DTN    = z_ref(Pred_DTN,         "DTN"),
           Han_Chlor  = z_ref(Pred_Chlorophyll, "Chlor")) %>%
    filter(month(with_tz(Date_Time, "Asia/Seoul")) %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
    select(Station, Date_Time, all_of(han_vars)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    distinct(Station, Date_Time, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
design <- function(d) model.matrix(dyn_formula, as.data.frame(d))[, rownames(ref_beta), drop = FALSE]

# Stationary distribution from exp(eta) (rows x 6, columns 1->2, 1->3, 2->1, 2->3, 3->1, 3->2)
stat_from_E <- function(E) {
  r1 <- 1 + E[, 1] + E[, 2]; r2 <- 1 + E[, 3] + E[, 4]; r3 <- 1 + E[, 5] + E[, 6]
  g12 <- E[, 1] / r1; g13 <- E[, 2] / r1; g21 <- E[, 3] / r2
  g23 <- E[, 4] / r2; g31 <- E[, 5] / r3; g32 <- E[, 6] / r3
  p <- cbind(g21 * g31 + g23 * g31 + g32 * g21,
             g12 * g32 + g13 * g32 + g31 * g12,
             g13 * g23 + g12 * g23 + g21 * g13)
  p / rowSums(p)
}
eig_stat <- function(x, beta) {
  eta <- matrix(x %*% beta, 3, 2, byrow = TRUE); G <- matrix(0, 3, 3)
  for (i in 1:3) { G[i, -i] <- exp(eta[i, ]); G[i, i] <- 1 }
  G <- G / rowSums(G); e <- eigen(t(G)); v <- Re(e$vectors[, which.min(abs(e$values - 1))]); v / sum(v)
}
X_chk <- design(ref_model$data)[1:50, ]
stopifnot(max(abs(stat_from_E(exp(X_chk %*% ref_beta)) - t(apply(X_chk, 1, eig_stat, beta = ref_beta)))) < 1e-8)
```

```{r bout design}
    mutate(Date_Time = roundT + years(Wf - Wh))                  # NA for 29 Feb in non-leap years
  fut <- lapply(fc_list, function(fc)
    left_join(h[, c("Station", "Date_Time")], fc, by = c("Station", "Date_Time"), na_matches = "never"))
  stopifnot(all(vapply(fut, nrow, integer(1)) == nrow(h)))

       seg_start = c(TRUE, hk$ID[-1] != hk$ID[-n] | diff(as.numeric(hk$roundT)) > 3660),
       u = runif(n),                                             # common random numbers
       X = c(list(Historical = design(hk)), lapply(fut, function(d) design(d[ok, ]))))
})
```

```{r bout simulation}
# Hourly state sequences for all K coefficient draws at once (X: n x p, D: K x 6p)
sim_bouts <- function(X, D, seg_start, u) {
  n <- nrow(X); K <- nrow(D); p <- ncol(X); kk <- seq_len(K)
  E <- exp(X %*% matrix(t(D), p)); dim(E) <- c(n, 6, K)          # E[t, transition, draw]
  a_of <- c(2L, 1L, 1L); b_of <- c(3L, 3L, 2L)                    # targets of each state's 2 off-diagonals
  S <- matrix(0L, n, K)
  for (t in seq_len(n)) {
    if (seg_start[t]) {
      P <- stat_from_E(t(matrix(E[t, , ], 6, K)))                 # first state ~ stationary distribution
    } else {
      s  <- S[t - 1, ]; e <- matrix(E[t - 1, , ], 6, K)           # transition into t uses covariates at t-1
      e1 <- e[cbind(2L * s - 1L, kk)]; e2 <- e[cbind(2L * s, kk)]; r <- 1 + e1 + e2
      P  <- matrix(0, K, 3)
      P[cbind(kk, s)] <- 1 / r; P[cbind(kk, a_of[s])] <- e1 / r; P[cbind(kk, b_of[s])] <- e2 / r
    }
    S[t, ] <- 1L + (u[t] > P[, 1]) + (u[t] > P[, 1] + P[, 2])
  }
  S
}
# Bouts per day (entries within segments per 24 tracked hours), mean bout (h, runs entirely within a
# segment) and mean gap between bouts of each state (h, complete runs of other states between two bouts
# of that state, entirely within a segment; same definition as 06)
bout_metrics <- function(S, seg_start) {
  n <- nrow(S); seg_end <- c(seg_start[-1], TRUE)
  apply(S, 2, function(s) {
    first <- which(seg_start | c(TRUE, s[-1] != s[-n])); last <- c(first[-1] - 1L, n)
    rs <- s[first]; len <- last - first + 1L
    entry <- !seg_start[first]
    full  <- !seg_start[first] & !seg_end[last]
    gap <- function(k) {
      x  <- s == k
      f2 <- which(seg_start | c(TRUE, x[-1] != x[-n])); l2 <- c(f2[-1] - 1L, n)
      g  <- (l2 - f2 + 1L)[!x[f2] & !seg_start[f2] & !seg_end[l2]]
      if (length(g)) mean(g) else NA_real_
    }
    c(tabulate(rs[entry], 3) * 24 / n,
      vapply(1:3, function(k) { x <- len[full & rs == k]; if (length(x)) mean(x) else NA_real_ }, numeric(1)),
      vapply(1:3, gap, numeric(1)))
  })
}
# One imputation: metric x period x draw, averaged over paired winters within each draw
bout_one <- function(b, V, Z, des) {
  R <- with(eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE), vectors %*% (sqrt(pmax(values, 0)) * t(vectors)))
  D <- sweep(Z %*% R, 2, c(b), "+")
  arr <- array(NA_real_, c(length(metric_names), length(des[[1]]$X), length(des), nrow(Z)))
  for (w in seq_along(des)) for (pp in seq_along(des[[w]]$X)) {
    d <- des[[w]]
    arr[, pp, w, ] <- bout_metrics(sim_bouts(d$X[[pp]], D, d$seg_start, d$u), d$seg_start)
  }
  out <- apply(arr, c(1, 2, 4), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  dimnames(out) <- list(metric_names, names(des[[1]]$X), NULL)
  out
}
bout_task <- function(tk) {
  if (file.exists(tk$file)) return(readRDS(tk$file))
  res <- bout_one(tk$b, tk$V, Z_bout, design_bout)
  saveRDS(res, tk$file)
  res
}

set.seed(2028)
Z_bout <- matrix(rnorm(n_draws * length(ref_beta)), n_draws)   # shared deviates for every imputation

bout_tasks <- lapply(use, function(j)   # delete the cached files if the design or settings change
  list(j = j, b = fits[[j]]$dyn$mle$beta, V = beta_vcov(fits[[j]]$dyn),
       file = file.path(paths$out_dir, sprintf("mi_%s_bouts_m%d_%s_K%d.rds",            # m9 = with gap metrics
                                               run_tag, length(metric_names), j, n_draws))))

clusterExport(cl, c("stat_from_E", "sim_bouts", "bout_metrics", "bout_one",
                    "design_bout", "Z_bout", "metric_names"), envir = environment())
bout_res <- tryCatch(parLapplyLB(cl, bout_tasks, bout_task), finally = stopCluster(cl))
names(bout_res) <- vapply(bout_tasks, `[[`, character(1), "j")
```

```{r pool bouts}
contrast_draws <- function(res, mt, s) res[mt, s, ] - res[mt, "Historical", ]

bout_mi <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s) bind_rows(lapply(metric_names, function(mt) {
  dj <- sapply(use, function(j) contrast_draws(bout_res[[j]], mt, s))            # draws x imputations
  r  <- rubin(colMeans(dj, na.rm = TRUE), apply(dj, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE))
  tibble(Metric    = factor(sub(" \\|.*", "", mt), levels = metric_types),
         Behavior  = factor(sub(".*\\| ", "", mt), levels = behav),
         contrast  = paste0(s, ": (Future - Historical)"),
         Pooled_MI = r[["Est"]],
         Lower_MI  = r[["Lower"]],
         Upper_MI  = r[["Upper"]])
})))) %>%
  arrange(Metric, Behavior, contrast)
```
